---
title: "01_load"
format: html
---

```{r}

library(GEOquery)
library(here)

# Download the processed Series Matrix and annotations
gse <- getGEO("GSE114489", GSEMatrix = TRUE)
eset <- gse[[1]]

# Extract the two datasets
expression <- Biobase::exprs(eset)
metadata <- Biobase::pData(eset)

# Inspect the metadata
dim(metadata)
colnames(metadata)
View(metadata)

# Create data folder if needed
dir.create(here("data"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# Save datasets
write.csv(metadata, here("data", "GSE114489_metadata.csv"))
write.csv(expression, here("data", "GSE114489_expression.csv"))

```
